problem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by finding the inverse of the coefficient matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}3z-y+x-5=0 \\ y+2x+2z=1 \\ z-2x-2y=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
We organize the system so that it’s in the correct order first:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-y+3z=5 \\ 2x+y+2z=1 \\ -2x-2y+z=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

We wish to write this system in the form $Ax=b$, where $A$ is a $3\times 3$ matrix and $x$ and $b$ are $3\times 1$ column vectors. We can do this as follows:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & 2 \\ -2 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, the solution to $Ax=b$ is given by $x={A}^{-1}b.$ So, we compute ${A}^{-1}$ as follows:

*Step 1:*

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & 2 \\ -2 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =1|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}|-(-1)|\begin{aligned}2 & 2 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}|+3|\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -2 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1(1+4)+1(2+4)+3(-4+2) \\  & =5+6-6 \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 2:*

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}2 & 2 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ -2 & -2\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ -2 & -2\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}|\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 6 & -2 \\ 5 & 7 & -4 \\ -5 & -4 & 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 3:*

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}5 & -6 & -2 \\ -5 & 7 & 4 \\ -5 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 4:*

$$
{C}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}5 & -5 & -5 \\ -6 & 7 & 4 \\ -2 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 5:*

$$
{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{det(A)}{C}^{T}=\frac{1}{5}[\begin{aligned}5 & -5 & -5 \\ -6 & 7 & 4 \\ -2 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Hence

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{5}[\begin{aligned}5 & -5 & -5 \\ -6 & 7 & 4 \\ -2 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -\frac{19}{5} \\ -\frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Hence the solution is $x=3,y=-\frac{19}{5},z=-\frac{3}{5}.$
